title: A Promise for the Kitchen
author: Noor Halloran
blurb: Ada Delacroix, a wedding planner who doesn't believe in weddings anymore, believes second chances are for people with better timing. Then a fake date to survive a family reunion feels too real by dessert — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must choose between the career that saved everything and the person who sees clearly at last before the festival ends.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
